title: MSc in Smart Cities and Communities (SMACCs)
institution: SMACCs (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Smart Cities and Communities)
field: Smart cities, energy and urban sustainability
about: The Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Smart Cities and Communities (SMACCs) is accepting applications for September 2027 entry. Applicants seeking Erasmus Mundus or other scholarships must apply by 1 February 2027 and are told their status by May 2027; cohorts are capped at 40 students.
card_alt: Card for the MSc in Smart Cities and Communities (SMACCs) from SMACCs (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Smart Cities and Communities); apply by 1 Feb 2027. The photo is a generic city skyline over a river at sunset, not a programme location.
